title: Slack-style messaging rebuild for 1M users
summary: Replaces the conversations/messages system with channel-first chat (docs/plans/messaging-slack-rebuild-report.md). 0180 adds chat_* tables (hash-partitioned messages, attachments, reactions), app_private chat functions, live-card triggers, member-scoped RLS and chat:channel/chat:user Realtime topic branches next to the old system; the app switches over behind NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_V3, and 0181 drops the old system at cutover.
concurrencyRisk: High write concurrency on the send path: each send takes the channel row lock for one statement to allocate a gap-free channel_seq (bounded at ~300 sends/s per channel, ledger L-17). Idempotency is by (channel_id, author_id, client_message_id) checked under that lock. Mentions and @channel fan-out are bounded by the 500-member cap and the 100-member @channel cap. Realtime publishing is best-effort after commit with catch-up on reconnect (L-1).

rollback.strategy: Before cutover: turn NEXT_PUBLIC_CHAT_V3 off (old system untouched) or git revert the chat commits; 0180 is additive and harmless if unused. After 0181 is applied there is no data rollback; a pg_dump of the old tables is taken first for forensics.
